full_prompt_en: A square Baroque-inspired oil portrait shows a dark-haired young woman from the shoulders up, her face turned in left profile and tilted slightly back. Her eyes are closed, and the red lips and exposed throat give the pose a quiet sensuality. A large pale cloth flower is fastened beside the back of her head. Around the neck, an oversized white ruff forms a sculptural ring of folded fabric, sharply contrasting with the deep red velvet garment below. The background is very dark olive-black and contains no described objects. The face is modeled with smooth warm ivory and peach transitions, while ruff folds carry cream highlights and gray-brown shadow. The red garment has broad velvety strokes, with dark seams following the shoulder. A narrow light from upper left touches the forehead, nose, throat, flower, and ruff edge, leaving hair and the far side of the neck in shadow. The close crop makes the profile, white fabric, and red mass nearly fill the frame. Edges are precise along the face and ruff but softened where the dress merges with the ground. The overall image is theatrical yet restrained, drawing its power from classical light-dark contrast, tactile fabric, and a poised, inward expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形巴洛克气息油画肖像描绘一位深发年轻女子的肩上半身，脸朝左侧面并略向后仰。她闭着眼，红唇与露出的喉部给姿态安静的感官感。一朵大型浅色布花固定在后脑旁。颈上宽大的白色褶领构成雕塑般折布环，与下方深红天鹅绒衣服形成尖锐对比。背景极深橄榄黑，没有描述的物件。脸由平滑暖象牙与桃色过渡塑形，褶领则有奶油高光和灰棕阴影。红衣用宽阔绒感笔触绘出，深缝顺肩延伸。一道窄光从左上照到额、鼻、喉、布花和褶领边，头发与远侧颈留在影里。贴近裁切让侧脸、白布和红色团块几乎占满画幅。脸与褶领边缘准确，裙子并入底色处则柔和。整体戏剧化却克制，其力量来自古典明暗对照、可触布料和端正内敛神情。
style_prompt_en: Baroque-inspired oil painting pairs luminous smooth flesh-like modeling with sculptural folded fabric and velvety red masses. Ivory, cream, deep crimson, and olive-black form a narrow dramatic palette. A single upper-side light catches raised planes and lets hair and outer cloth dissolve into darkness. Focal contours stay precise, while lower edges soften into the ground. Broad paint in dark fabric contrasts with careful small transitions on pale surfaces. The close composition feels theatrical, sensual, and restrained, built around classical light-dark tension and tactile materials.
style_prompt_zh: 巴洛克气息油画把发亮平滑的肤色塑形与雕塑般折布、绒感红色大块配对。象牙、奶油、深红与橄榄黑构成窄而戏剧的配色。单一上侧光照亮凸起平面，让头发和外层布料溶入黑暗。焦点轮廓精确，下方边缘柔化进入底层。深布宽笔对照浅面谨慎细小过渡。贴近构图戏剧化、富感官而克制，依靠古典明暗张力与可触材料建立。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in red with an oversized white ruff
theme_zh: 穿红衣戴宽大白色褶领的深发女子
name: Roberto Ferri
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
